dispute.claim_text: I stood in the rain for over twenty minutes. The car never moved. I called four, five times. The chatbot kept repeating the ETA I could already see. So I cancelled. Then I got a message that the driver was punished and honestly I feel bad — I didn't want him punished, I wanted to know why he never came. I don't even care about the four dollars that much. Or maybe I do.

counterparty_statement.text: I had accepted the job but my app froze. By the time it came back she had cancelled. I didn't ignore her on purpose.
